---
title: "Geometry and SGB Route A/B"
---

Semantic Geometry Builder (SGB) is the authority for geometry and topology.
SCGSim consumes its stable identities and must not reconstruct geometry meaning
from solver-generated labels.

## Current Surface-EPR direction

| Route | Public intent | Current state |
|---|---|---|
| Route A | Thin-film or surface-based semantic handoff | Planned consumer path |
| Route B | Closed PEC boundary shell around excluded conductor interior; the metal interior is not volume-meshed or solved | Planned consumer path |

Only Route A and Route B are in the current direction. Their availability in
SGB does not make a solver backend implemented.

## Identity requirements

A future handoff must preserve:

- source SGB revision;
- semantic surface and volume identities;
- route choice and topology receipt;
- generated mesh/config identity;
- the mapping from solver entities back to semantic geometry.

The starting SGB authority is
`e74a343154c6b19b6ba32d6fb297e700cfe08ff2`.
